entities.title: The cockpit
entities.summary: The player's in-flight state that is not saved.
entities.purpose: Holds what a flight-state reset sets again (RULES C.1, C.6–C.10, D.3.13): energy and shields, temperatures, altitude, speed, attitude, the active mount, the missile lock, the E.C.M. and area-blast timers, the main counter and the timed message, with the small operations on them.
boundaries: A capability: it uses no feature or use case (tests/layers.rs).
What is saved is the pilot capability's.
Nothing here draws a random number except Cockpit::reset, which discards the 54 stardust draws.
